description: This file contains pytest-based unit tests for the LightningjsTemplate class and related project initialization logic within a larger project scaffolding tool. It includes fixtures for setting up mock template directories and configurations, as well as tests for template info retrieval, project initialization, post-processing execution, config loading, and variable substitution in templates.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory fixture for test outputs.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates a mock template directory with configuration and template files for testing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates and returns a sample ProjectConfig object for testing.

methods.name: test_lightningjs_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests retrieval of initialization info from the LightningjsTemplate.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the project initialization process including file creation and content substitution.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures post-processing scripts are executed and the marker file is created.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Verifies loading of project configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Checks that template variables are correctly replaced with project parameters in output files.
